acceptance: Canonical closeout advances only KX-P03-S03-T01 and leaves KX-P03-S04-T01 and all later work unproven until their own authorized Grains.
Center and edge docking are deterministic, never duplicate or lose a moved pane, preserve unaffected layout branches, and select a valid active/focus target after move or close.

Keyboard navigation provides roving tab focus, Arrow/Home/End tab movement, deterministic activation and focus recovery, orientation-aware split resizing in frozen 500-basis-point steps, and an escape/traversal path that prevents workspace focus traps.

Native Linux, macOS and Windows qualification passes the focused workspace corpus plus the existing desktop/workspace/protocol/SpecGrain/typecheck/format/lint baseline on the exact implementation revision.
Native SpecGrain verification binds the frozen WorkPacket to observed evidence with zero issues before any PROVEN transition.

Reducer operations for open, activate, close, move, tab, split, dock and resize preserve unique pane identity, non-empty reachable tab groups, valid ratios and deterministic empty-container collapse; identical inputs and operations serialize identically.

Renderer integration remains pure and unprivileged, does not widen preload/bridge/daemon authority, preserves the single connection projection, and does not implement KX-P03-S04-T01 or real later pane contents.

Task-driven opening adds only missing required pane kinds, preserves unrelated user panes and valid user layout choices, and opens the minimum additional surfaces needed for the declared requirement set.

Version-1 persistence round trips to canonical stable bytes through an injected renderer-safe storage contract and fails closed on malformed, unknown-version, duplicate-ID, unknown-kind, oversized, over-depth, over-pane-count, invalid-ratio, or impossible-tree input without overwriting recoverable saved bytes.

Workspace accessibility projection exposes coherent tablist/tab/tabpanel and separator semantics including selected/control/orientation/value metadata, while focus and status meaning remain non-color-only and reuse the proven design-system contract.

WorkspaceLayout v1 is closed, deterministic, immutable-by-contract, uses stable unique identifiers and the frozen pane-kind vocabulary, enforces 64-pane/16-depth/65536-byte bounds, and validates split basis-point ratios in the frozen 1000..9000 range.

Bind the live P03 frontier: S02-T01 is PROVEN and only KX-P03-S03-T01 is authorized next.
Bind S03.3 adaptive-pane scope and keep S03.4+ feature work outside this Grain.
Bind precedence, bounded delivery, exact-head qualification, mandatory Jev/OCR review, negative evidence, and protected-history rules.
Bind the existing renderer integration surface that the workspace projection may extend without gaining host authority.
Bind the immediately preceding native qualification, Jev/OCR accounting, exact-head, and proof-bearing closeout precedent.
Bind the complete frozen SG-000034 outcome, acceptance, limits, evidence, recovery, safety, and authorized change surface.
Bind KX-P03-S03-T01 outcome, R1 floor, proven design-system dependency, later-task exclusions, and P03 gate context.
Bind the proven SG-000033 primitive contract so adaptive-pane semantics reuse instead of fork the design system.
Bind the proven tokenized styling authority and prevent ad-hoc workspace styling drift.
Bind the task-driven adaptive workspace, dock/split/tab model, minimum-surface opening, and remembered user layout choices.

outcome: Implement a deterministic renderer-safe adaptive workspace layout model with tabs, splits, docking, versioned persistence, task-driven minimal pane opening, and keyboard-first navigation without widening renderer authority or implementing later pane content.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded workspace-layout, keyboard, persistence, renderer integration, tests, evidence and frontier changes; retain the proven SG-000033 design-system state and keep KX-P03-S03-T01 as NEXT. No daemon, host, secret, external side effect or irreversible user data migration is created by this Grain.

scope_in: Add deterministic unit/adversarial coverage for reducer invariants, docking/move/close edge cases, canonical persistence round trips and hostile inputs, task-driven minimal opening, keyboard navigation/focus recovery, accessibility descriptors, and renderer authority preservation.

Define a closed immutable WorkspaceLayout v1 tree with stable node and pane identifiers, tab-group and split nodes, and the canonical pane-kind vocabulary Agent, Browser, Computer, Terminal, Files, Diff, Artifact, Data, and Timeline; reject duplicate identifiers and structurally invalid trees.

Expose semantic workspace projection descriptors for tablist/tab/tabpanel and split separator behavior with selected/control/orientation/value metadata; status or focus meaning must never depend on color alone and the proven design-system focus/reduced-motion contract remains authoritative.

Freeze deterministic bounded layout limits: at most 64 panes, tree depth at most 16, canonical serialized layout at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes, split ratios represented as integer basis points from 1000 through 9000, default 5000, and keyboard resize step 500.

Implement WorkspaceLayout persistence as canonical version-1 JSON with deterministic serialization and a renderer-safe injected storage adapter; round trips preserve user choices, while malformed JSON, unknown versions/kinds, duplicate identifiers, invalid ratios, excess size/depth/pane counts, and structurally impossible layouts fail closed without overwriting the last recoverable bytes.

Implement deterministic reducer operations for open, activate, close, move, tab, split, dock, and resize; center docking joins a tab group, edge docking creates a split, pane identity remains unique, empty containers collapse deterministically, and identical input plus operation sequences produce identical state.

Implement keyboard-first workspace navigation: roving tab focus with Arrow/Home/End behavior, deterministic activation and focus recovery after close/move, keyboard split resizing with orientation-aware arrows and frozen bounds, and traversal that cannot trap focus inside the workspace.

Implement task-driven pane opening that adds only missing required pane kinds, does not silently close unrelated user panes, preserves user arrangement and active selection where valid, and selects a deterministic focus target when a pane is added, moved, or closed.

Integrate only enough of the adaptive workspace into apps/desktop/src/renderer.tsx to prove the framework against the existing pure renderer; preserve the single daemon connection authority and leave project rail, command-bar behavior, onboarding/empty states, run-strip feature work, and real pane contents to their later canonical tasks.

Persist fresh canonical ContextSources and a pinned WorkPacket before implementation, require byte-identical packet replay, exact-head CI, Diffcipline R1, genuine Jev review, Alibaba OpenCodeReview accounting, native Linux/macOS/Windows desktop qualification, native SpecGrain proof, and protected closeout before PROVEN.
scope_out: No KX-P03-S04-T01 behavior: no project management/rail implementation, command execution behavior, onboarding or empty-state journeys, run-strip feature expansion, or task proposal UX.

No implementation of Agent, Browser, Computer, Terminal, Files, Diff, Artifact, Data, or Timeline pane feature contents; this Grain provides only the workspace framework and typed pane identity/projection needed to host them later.

No new daemon/kernel capability, bridge channel, arbitrary filesystem/process/network authority, Electron/Node ambient renderer access, secret handling, egress change, or alteration of the proven connection/reconnect authority.
No new npm dependency, component framework, donor source import, packaging/signing/updater work, release artifact, or later P03/P04 feature implementation.
No operating-system floating windows, multi-window detachment, cross-device layout sync, collaborative layout state, cloud persistence, provider-specific UI, or mobile/web workspace implementation.
